description: A health informatics company's workforce analytics team needs 4 business intelligence answers from the Oracle HR database. Using Oracle analytical SQL (window functions, CTEs, subqueries), answer all 4 questions and save the results to /home/ga/Desktop/workforce_analytics_report.txt. The 4 questions are: (Q1) Which city has the highest average employee salary? Report the city name and average salary rounded to 2 decimal places. (Q2) Which manager has the widest direct reporting span (most direct reports)? Report their full name and direct report count. (Q3) What is the average percentage salary increase when an employee changes jobs (comparing salary at start of new role vs end of previous role in JOB_HISTORY joined to current EMPLOYEES salary)? Round to 2 decimal places. (Q4) Which job title has the highest employee mobility (most employees who have held that job at some point, including historically via JOB_HISTORY)? Report job title and count. The report file must label each answer clearly with Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4.
